info.title: DevMentor API
info.description: Financial amounts are strings of minor units. UTC timestamps plus IANA timezones. No private cache. Errors are stable codes, never SQL/stacks. Native BetterAuth endpoints /api/auth/* expose email verification, MFA and confirmed email change; direct signup is restricted to versioned register wrapper.

sessionCookie.name: better-auth.session_token
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly session. Production uses __Secure- cookie prefix and requires verified email; administrative endpoints require session-bound MFA.
